verdict.rationale: Skyvern's docs and GitHub claim it can autonomously navigate, fill forms, and complete multi-step flows on any site via natural-language goals, and features like login/2FA handling, CAPTCHA solving, and artifact capture back this up. However, hands-on community testing directly contradicts the 'works on unseen sites without customization' claim: a tester reported it handled the Geico example well but failed on costcotravel.com, unable to click a rental-car tab and getting stuck on a popup after filling in location data — a concrete real-world failure of end-to-end task completion on a non-trivial flow. Missing for 10: independent benchmark results, broader corroboration of success rates across varied real-world sites, and resolution of the documented failure case.
